channel.title: Research notes · Julius Störk
channel.description: Interactive notes on continual learning and electrode manufacturing.

item.title: Getting Less Wrong Without Becoming Certain
item.description: A review of the Sequences through Hume, Bayesian inference and the ethics of optimization, with an interactive example of independent evidence versus repeated reports.

item.title: Text to Trajectory
item.description: From language instructions to robot motion: grounding, checked plans, learned policies and a focused study in Visual Components.

item.title: ChargeWise Fits the Fleet to the Grid
item.description: The original hosted application, four-van capacity proof, tariff trade-offs, outage replanning, and a 26 October forecasting follow-up.

item.title: When Do AI Outputs Tip?
item.description: Measured head-content versus routing interventions, an interactive mathematical error clock, and ongoing experiments on matched present readouts with different internal states.

item.title: Gold Medals Don't Stack Batteries: Building Training Grounds for AI Agents
item.description: From RL textbooks and VERA to RoboReward, FLARE, REVOLVE, Isaac GR00T, and RoboDojo: how 2026 projects train rewards, recovery, and resets, with reported results and a proposed electrode-handling test design.

item.title: Price Wars: East vs. West Battery Production and the SynBatt Response
item.description: A sourced timeline of EV battery deployment and factory milestones, twenty reasons regional battery prices differ, six 2026 publications, and the SynBatt projects addressing manufacturing costs.

item.title: How to (Not) Reinvent the Wheel With Jeff
item.description: Jev, Jeff, and typed decisions: shared representations, task-specific heads, calibrated probabilities, and a concrete policy for when a manufacturing model acts or requests review.

item.title: DisCo and the Case for Reusable Agent Skills
item.description: DisCo distills repositories and papers into reusable operating skills. Scope, ground, construct, and verify: a practical route from research knowledge to repeatable workflows.

item.title: Reading ConvMem: Long-Context Reasoning as a Summary Tree
item.description: Reading notes on ConvMem (arXiv:2609.10441): hierarchical summarization with overlapping windows, skip connections and sub-question channels, compared with MemAgent, plus ideas for constant-depth long-context reasoning.

item.title: I Checked 2,294 arXiv Equations for Upside-Down Fractions
item.description: An exploratory LLM-assisted audit flags 112 of 2,294 display rows, including one strict fraction reversal. Reviewer accuracy and clipboard causation remain unmeasured.

item.title: I Ran a Game-Theory RL-Menu Agent in GLEE for 48 Hours (No LLM)
item.description: Debugging a no-LLM GLEE agent through reward normalisation, seat-matched comparisons and bargaining timing, with controlled results separated from live rankings.

item.title: Finding a Fair Evaluation Under Changing Representations
item.description: A proposed matched-input task for testing representation adaptation, with a frozen-feature ceiling, separate retention audits and resource-matched baselines.

item.title: The Student Becomes the Teacher
item.description: Self-distillation transfers a model’s own supervision. Majority pseudo-labels can correct minority errors or reinforce systematic mistakes; flatness alone guarantees neither generalisation nor retention.

item.title: From Simulating Speech to Optimizing Reasoning
item.description: What latent steering, multiplex tokens and compressed plans establish about reasoning, with measured hint acknowledgement and task-specific limits.

item.title: The Race to O(n)
item.description: Sparse patterns, DSA indexing, recurrent memory and conditional complexity bounds, with vendor claims separated from independent architectural evidence.

item.title: Lithium Dendrites Are Batteries' Dandelions
item.description: A lithium-and-sodium dendrite model linking defect geometry, fracture and electronic leakage, with an explicit sodium example and unresolved current-scale mismatch.

item.title: AI's Bottleneck Is Physical
item.description: Sensing, data lineage, latency and safe interventions constrain industrial AI. A bottleneck illustration and deployment examples, rather than a fitted scaling law.

item.title: Reading CausalPFN: Causal Effects as In-Context Prediction
item.description: Notes on Balazadeh et al., CausalPFN: one transformer, trained on simulated identifiable DGPs, that estimates treatment effects in-context.

item.title: The Geometry of Forgetting in Continual Learning
item.description: An exact fixed-feature squared-loss calculation at stationarity, its second-order extension, and frozen-backbone IGFA results on Rotated-Digits.

item.title: Modelling the Electrode Calendering U-Shape
item.description: Why through-plane conductivity dips before it rises, and the closure that captures it.
